entities.summary: Shigeru Miyamoto (b. 1952-11-16, Sonobe) was a filmmaker or theatre director of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Sonobe and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, architects & designers, asia.
